## Description

A second deliberately trivial, local-only task for the `devbench supervise`
integration fixture: append a single farewell line to `NOTES.md`. Like its
predecessor it edits one local text file and nothing else (no cloud, no
provisioning, no network, no build tooling). It depends on E1-F1-S1-T1 so the
fixture also exercises a one-edge dependency DAG.
